items.exampleEn: Someone in the audience kept rustling a paper bag.
items.exampleZh: 觀眾裡有人一直把紙袋弄得沙沙作響。

items.exampleEn: Reporters prowled the hotel lobby, hoping to see the star.
items.exampleZh: 記者在飯店大廳裡四處徘徊，希望能見到那位明星。

items.exampleEn: The cook stoked the old iron stove with wood every hour.
items.exampleZh: 廚師每個小時往那座老鐵爐裡添一次柴。

items.exampleEn: The storm dislodged several tiles from the roof.
items.exampleZh: 暴風雨把屋頂上的幾片瓦吹得鬆脫移位。

items.exampleEn: Historians retraced the explorer's journey across the desert.
items.exampleZh: 歷史學家沿著那位探險家穿越沙漠的路線重走了一遍。

items.exampleEn: The audience sat transfixed by the dancer's performance.
items.exampleZh: 觀眾被那位舞者的表演深深吸引，看得入迷不動。

items.exampleEn: Most roses sold in shops have been grafted onto wild roots.
items.exampleZh: 店裡賣的玫瑰，大多是嫁接在野生的根上。

items.sentenceEn: It took two of us to dislodge the rock from the path.
items.sentenceZh: 我們兩個人合力才把那塊石頭從小路上挪開。

items.audioEn: After the meeting, I retraced my route to the station, but I never found my umbrella.
items.audioZh: 會議結束後，我沿原路走回車站，但始終沒找到我的傘。
items.questionZh: 說話者沿原路走回車站，結果如何？
options: It was in the speaker's bag.
Someone had handed it in at the station office.
It was still lying under the meeting table.

items.sentenceEn: The bright lights of the car transfixed the deer in the road.
items.sentenceZh: 車子刺眼的燈光讓路中間的鹿呆住不動。

items.sentenceEn: We took turns stoking the fire to keep the cabin warm.
items.sentenceZh: 我們輪流給爐火添柴，讓小木屋保持溫暖。

items.stemEn: Lost in the old town, we ____ our steps to the last square we recognized.
items.stemZh: 我們在老城區迷了路，於是循原路走回最後一個認得的廣場。

items.stemEn: The only sound in the library was the ____ of pages being turned.
items.stemZh: 圖書館裡唯一的聲音，是翻書時紙頁的沙沙聲。

items.passageEn: Every spring, my uncle grafts branches from his best apple trees onto younger ones, and last year he let me help. One evening after work, we sat outside while he stoked a small fire. Suddenly the dry leaves behind us rustled. A fox was prowling near the chicken house, its eyes shining in the flickering light. My little cousin was so transfixed that she could not move. My uncle threw a stick, which dislodged a stone from the wall, and the noise sent the fox running. Later, I realized I had dropped my phone, so I retraced my steps to the orchard with a torch and found it under a tree.
items.passageZh: 每年春天，我叔叔都會把他最好的蘋果樹的枝條嫁接到較年輕的樹上，去年他讓我一起幫忙。有一天傍晚收工後，我們坐在外面，他往一小堆火裡添柴。突然，我們身後的枯葉沙沙作響。一隻狐狸正在雞舍附近徘徊，牠的眼睛在搖曳的火光中發亮。我的小表妹看得呆住，動也不動。叔叔丟出一根樹枝，把牆上的一塊石頭打得鬆脫，那聲響把狐狸嚇跑了。後來，我發現手機掉了，於是拿著手電筒循原路走回果園，在一棵樹下找到了它。

questions.questionZh: 狐狸出現時，小表妹有什麼反應？
options: 大聲尖叫著跑進屋裡找大人

questions.questionZh: 作者後來為什麼回到果園？
options: 去幫叔叔把剩下的樹枝嫁接完

items.promptZh: 那隻貓整晚都在房子四周悄悄徘徊。
referenceEn: The cat prowled around the house all night.
All night long, the cat was prowling around the house.
rubricZh: 「悄悄徘徊」用 prowl，可接 around＋地點，也可直接接地點（例如 prowl around the house、prowl the garden）
時態配合內容（例如 prowled、was prowling）
「整晚」可寫，例如 all night、all night long 等

items.promptZh: 我們重走了爺爺年輕時每天上學走的那條路。
referenceEn: We retraced the route that Grandpa walked to school every day when he was young.
We retraced the path my grandfather took to school each day as a boy.
rubricZh: 「重走」用 retrace（例如 retraced the route、retraced the path 等）
「爺爺」可寫，例如 Grandpa、my grandfather 等
說的是已發生的事，時態配合內容（例如 retraced、have retraced 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確
